nodes.speaker: Finnian
nodes.text: Ah, a fellow traveler! I am Finnian, wandering bard and collector of tales. Care to hear a story?

choices.label: Tell me about the goblin ambush

nodes.speaker: Finnian
nodes.text: Ah, the goblins! Let me paint the picture for you... close your eyes and imagine...

nodes.speaker: Finnian
nodes.text: No worries, friend! I'll be here strumming away if you change your mind.

nodes.speaker: Finnian
nodes.text: Welcome back! I'm working on some new songs. Come back later and I might have a fresh tale for you!
